suggestion.topic: Acing the System Design Interview: Distributed Cache Scaling
suggestion.rationale: System design interview prep is a perennial high-search traffic category. Condensing complex scaling topologies into a 3-minute vertical format hits peak engagement.
suggestion.hook_angle: If an interviewer asks you to scale a Redis cluster to 100k writes per second, don't just say 'add a load balancer'. Do this instead.
